title: Seer
extract:
The Seer is Captain Vor's specialized pistol of Grineer design utilizing Orokin technology, creating a unique hybrid weapon. It features higher than average zoom and high, balanced damage making it potent at long range, but has very poor critical stats and a slow reload speed.

Characteristics
This weapon deals equal physical damage.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

High zoom, excellent for long range.
Very fast projectile speed.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average total damage (101.01)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
High ammo max (210)
Very high disposition (●●●●● (1.50x))
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Projectiles have travel time.
High zoom capabilities can make zooming in at close range a hindrance. High zoom also amplifies perceived recoil when aiming.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Very low crit chance (5.00%)
Low burst DPS (207.07)
Very low sustained DPS (121.80)
Low magazine size (8)
Low accuracy (0.50° to 12.00°)
Very low reload speed (2.80 s)
Very low fire rate (2.00 attacks/sec)
Below average status chance (13.00%)
Very low crit multiplier (1.50x)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition
Seer's main blueprint and components can be obtained from defeating Captain Vor on Tolstoj, Mercury.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Notes
Though the shot explodes on impact, the effect is purely graphical. This weapon has no blast radius/area of effect.
Although the explosive shot has no AOE, killing an enemy with the Seer usually results in them being thrown a reasonable distance
Multishot can be observed with long range shots, but is not noticeable short-to-medium range.
Tint Color 4 has a small shade change on parts colored by Tint Color 1.

Known Bugs
 Galvanized Shot is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits.

Tips
Use it for stationary mid-long range targets (or easy to track targets), the bullet travel time and the gun's slow fire rate makes it hard to use on moving targets and for some reason it misses extremely close targets.
When using multishot mods you can decrease the spread of the extra shot(s) by zooming in, or fire from the hip to increase the chance of headshots (as the multiple shots will spread out slightly).
Hip firing the Seer provides enough spread to the projectiles that it may be easier to hit longer range and/or moving targets.
The Seer has reasonably strong recoil when zoomed in. Consider using  Steady Hands to make it more controllable; when maxed out, the Seer's recoil should be almost completely unnoticeable.

Trivia
The Seer's components used to have the same drop algorithm as the  Cronus blueprint; every subsequent visit to Tolstoj used to decrease the drop rate. This has since been fixed.
The bulb on the right side of the weapon is the magazine. Prior to Update 12.0 (2014-02-05) the bulb on the right side of the weapon rotated when the gun was reloaded, and the Seer had the default sidearm reload animation.
This is the first hybrid weapon that combines Orokin design with another technological base, in this case Grineer technology. The  Twin Rogga and Aegrit are currently the only other hybrid weapons that likely combine Orokin design.
Prior to Update 12.0 (2014-02-05), the energy color customization option had no effect on the color of the projectile's trail.
The slash damage is actually a tiny bit less than the other damages, shown when using a max damage and multishot build, the UI will show the slash damage to be 1 or more less than the others.
A "Seer" is a person of supposed supernatural insight who sees visions of the future, which is apt to Vor when he later becomes Corrupted.
While the small explosions on impact are only visual for PvE, for PvP the weapon has 40  Blast damage.
Before Update 22.12 (2018-02-09), this weapon had 0% crit chance and crit damage.
